verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents building blocks that speed bring-up: an ecosystem spanning "drivers to state-of-the-art algorithms," a launch system for coordinating nodes, runtime parameters, CLI introspection, `ros2 doctor`, and Gazebo simulation. Practitioners corroborate the speed: ROS gets teams "from nothing to something faster than anything," with bagging, visualization, teleop and sim "for free" and a large body of existing drivers. Other users report dependency hell, heavy build boilerplate, multi-format configuration complexity and disorganized tutorials, which cut against an hours-not-weeks bring-up. missing for 10: first-party docs for a hardware bring-up workflow (driver integration, robot description/configuration, motor control to first motion), any evidence of hours-scale bring-up times, and a smoother setup and learning path.
